# Milestone 4 delivery: Concordia (CAP) - Auctions Module Expansion

Hello everyone — the Milestone 4 deliverables are complete and public in the project repository: **https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia** (Apache-2.0, branch `m4`).

M4 expands `cap-auctions`. The library now covers sealed-bid and Dutch clock auctions over a divisible lot, with three pricing rules: first price, uniform price, and Vickrey. Every format settles through Token Standard V2 allocations with 
(1 round) iterated settlement.
A short intro to the library can be found in [`intro.md`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/docs/auctions/intro.md).

**What changed since M3.**
- `cap-auctions` was rebuilt on Token Standard V2. The `OneLotBid` interface was replaced by `TradeProposal`, `BidProposal`, `Bid`, `SingleLotQuotesBid` and `Settlement`, one for each contract a wallet or app needs to read or act on. The mechanism logic lives in opt-in helpers, as in `cap-governance` (we would greatly appreciate feedback).
- `cap-auctions` has its own unit and ledger tests.

## Deliverables

| M4 deliverable | Where to look |
| --- | --- |
| Sealed-bid first-price and second-price auction support | Utils: [`SingleLot.daml`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/cap-auctions/utils/daml/Cap/Auctions/SingleLot.daml), [`Clearing.daml`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/cap-auctions/utils/daml/Cap/Auctions/Clearing.daml), [`Funding.daml`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/cap-auctions/utils/daml/Cap/Auctions/Funding.daml), [`Terms.daml`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/cap-auctions/utils/daml/Cap/Auctions/Terms.daml) · Example: [`sealed-single-lot/impl`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/examples/auctions/sealed-single-lot/impl) |
| Dutch auction implementation | Utils: same as sealed, plus [`Clock.daml`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/cap-auctions/utils/daml/Cap/Auctions/Clock.daml) · Example: [`dutch-single-lot/impl`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/examples/auctions/dutch-single-lot/impl) |
| Multi-unit auction implementation | Example: [`examples/auctions/demo`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/examples/auctions/demo) |
| Daml script and sandbox integration tests for supported auction formats | [`examples/auctions/demo`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/examples/auctions/demo): the sealed uniform-price and Dutch pay-as-bid happy paths, end to end across two token registries, run in memory and on a sandbox by [`scripts/sandbox-test.sh`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/scripts/sandbox-test.sh). Library tests in [`cap-auctions/tests`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/cap-auctions/tests) |

## Milestone verification

Daml SDK 3.5.11 via `dpm`, from the repository root. Run instructions, in memory and on a sandbox, are in [`README.md#running-the-demos`](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/README.md#running-the-demos).

| Package | Check | Expected output | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [all packages](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/multi-package.yaml) | `dpm build --all` | every package in `multi-package.yaml` compiles | the code of every M4 deliverable |
| [auction demos](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/examples/auctions/demo) | `dpm test --package-root examples/auctions/demo` | 2 scripts report **`ok`** | Daml Script integration tests: a sealed-bid auction and a Dutch auction, each selling 10 units across several bidders (multi-unit) |
| [`cap-auctions` unit tests](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/cap-auctions/tests/unit) | `dpm test --package-root cap-auctions/tests/unit` | 92 scripts report **`ok`** | sealed-bid first-price, uniform-price and second-price (Vickrey) pricing, the Dutch clock, and multi-unit clearing (test auction support) |
| [`cap-auctions` ledger tests](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/tree/m4/cap-auctions/tests/ledger) | `dpm test --package-root cap-auctions/tests/ledger` | 30 scripts report **`ok`** | Daml Script integration tests: clearing and settling a lot on a ledger, across two token registries (test auction support) |
| [all demos, on a ledger](https://github.com/unlockitio/concordia/blob/m4/scripts/sandbox-test.sh) | `./scripts/sandbox-test.sh` | 19 scripts report **`SUCCESS`** | sandbox integration tests: the auction demos (and the M2/M3 governance demos) |

## Notes for reviewers

We're happy to answer questions here or walk through any part of the auctions module.
We would greatly value your feedback.

## Vote created

**@hythloda** has called for a vote on `Concordia #184 - Milestone 4: Auctions Module Expansion` (#541).
  
The members of the following teams have binding votes:
| Team |
| ---- |
| @canton-foundation/tech-ops-voting |
  
Non-binding votes are also appreciated as a sign of support!

## How to vote

You can cast your vote by reacting to `this` comment. The following reactions are supported:

| In favor | Against | Abstain |
| :------: | :-----: | :-----: |
|    👍     |    👎    |    👀    |

*Please note that voting for multiple options is not allowed and those votes won't be counted.*

The vote will be open for `21days`. It will pass if at least `51%` of the users with binding votes vote `In favor 👍`. Once it's closed, results will be published here as a new comment.
